reconcile.note: Keil & Delitzsch read Ezra's "son of Levi" as shorthand for grandson, tracing Mahli's descent from Levi through Merari.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells of the Skeptic's Annotated Bible reads Ezra 8:18 against the Torah and Chronicles genealogies and lists Mahli's identity as a genuine contradiction.

sides.snippet: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
sides.verseText: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

sides.snippet: of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel
sides.verseText: According to the good hand of our God on us they brought us a man of discretion, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brothers, eighteen;
